code: import axios from'axios';const BASE_URL='http://127.0.0.1:8000/api';const getHeaders=()=>({headers:{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(localStorage.getItem('token'))}});export const getDrivers=async()=>{const response=await axios.get("".concat(BASE_URL,"/drivers"),getHeaders());return response;};export const createDriver=async data=>{const response=await axios.post("".concat(BASE_URL,"/drivers"),data,getHeaders());return response;};export const updateDriver=async(id,data)=>{const response=await axios.put("".concat(BASE_URL,"/drivers/").concat(id),data,getHeaders());return response;};export const deleteDriver=async id=>{const response=await axios.delete("".concat(BASE_URL,"/drivers/").concat(id),getHeaders());return response;};
